aboutParagraphs: I'm a Computer Science undergraduate at SLIIT with a strong interest in software engineering, backend development, and DevOps. I've worked on projects using technologies such as React, Spring Boot, Java, TypeScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. I enjoy understanding how different parts of a system fit together and turning concepts into practical, working applications.

I'm currently expanding my skills in cloud infrastructure, containerization, CI/CD, Linux, and platform engineering. Outside academics, I enjoy working on personal projects, participating in technical communities, and continuously learning through hands-on projects.
